observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow cooking gas cylinder with a top handle/valve area and a visible sticker/label area; cylinder has visible dents/scratches and some rust/marks.
Photo 1 shows a blue cooking gas cylinder with the top valve opening visible; cylinder has dents/scratches and wear.
Photo 2 shows the blue cylinder from above with the valve/regulator connection point visible; no clear weight marking is readable.

claims.evidence: No readable weight marking (e.g., 12.5kg) is visible in the provided photos; only general cylinder appearance and stickers are seen.

risks.risk: Cylinder weight/size may not be 12.5kg (could be different cylinder size).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed weight marking (12.5kg) and/or the cylinder neck/shoulder markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed 12.5kg (worst-case treated as a different/unknown size).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition may be poor (dents, corrosion, valve damage) affecting safety and exchange value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve/regulator connection area and any dents around the shoulder/body, plus a photo showing the cylinder base ring.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/possibly damaged (worst-case: reduced value due to condition).

risks.risk: Gas level is unknown (could be empty or low), which changes practical value.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the cylinder with a scale/weight check or a clear method used to confirm remaining gas (or a receipt/verification).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as empty/low (worst-case: minimal remaining gas).

risks.risk: Leak/valve integrity is unknown (photos can’t confirm sealing).
risks.proof: A simple leak test result (soap-bubble test at valve/regulator connection) shown on video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed leak-free (worst-case: treated as needing inspection).

risks.risk: Photos show two different cylinders (yellow and blue); seller may be offering one or multiple, or the wrong one.
risks.proof: Confirm whether the buyer will receive the yellow cylinder or the blue cylinder (or both) with a photo showing the exact cylinder being sold labeled/identified.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case ambiguity (treated as the less certain option).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed weight marking showing 12.5kg.
Photo of the valve/regulator connection area (front and side) with no glare, plus any visible damage.
Video of a soap-bubble leak test around the valve/regulator connection.
Photo/video confirming remaining gas level (scale/verified method) or proof of recent refill/exchange.
Confirm which cylinder is for sale (yellow or blue) and whether it’s one unit or multiple.
response.reason: The photos show worn cooking gas cylinders, but the key pricing driver—confirmed 12.5kg size and safe, leak-free condition with known remaining gas—is not verifiable from the provided images. Request the specific markings and leak/condition proof before pricing.
